profileEvidence.summary: Calm around the home and affectionate with its owner, the American Staghound is tenacious when coursing quarry. Bred for hunting ability rather than a uniform show type, its working lines combine speed with endurance over difficult terrain. Greyhound and Scottish Deerhound ancestry remains central, but established Staghound lines have also been bred to one another for generations.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: An affectionate, tenacious American coursing hound, combining speed and endurance in varied working lines.
